# VK

> > Russia's leading social and entertainment platform offering event ticketing, voice assistant technology, and digital services across theater, cinema, concerts, and more.

VK (formerly VKontakte) operates VK Билеты (VK Tickets) for purchasing tickets to cultural events across Russian cities including Moscow, Cheliabinsk, and Yaroslavl, as well as Marusia, a voice assistant platform with customizable skills. The platform features events ranging from Chekhov theatrical adaptations to tribute concerts and cinema releases.

## Key Topics

- VK Билеты (VK Tickets)
- Marusia voice assistant
- Theater performances
- Cinema ticketing
- Concert events
- Moscow cultural events
- Russian drama and comedy
- Anton Pavlovich Chekhov adaptations
- Tribute shows
- Event booking platform
- Cheliabinsk entertainment
- Yaroslavl venues
- Voice assistant skills
- Russian cinema
- Cultural event scheduling

## Event Ticketing Platform

- [Chekhov Sketches Theater Performance](https://tickets.vk.com/moskva/event/chekhov-eskizy-1117059): Theater event: Chekhov Sketches at MTC Vishnevy Sad, Moscow (Apr 2026)
- [Nightwish Tribute Show Concert](https://tickets.vk.com/iaroslavl/event/nightwish-tribute-show-866068): Concert: Nightwish Tribute Show at Territoriya Club, Yaroslavl (Apr 2026)

## Cinema Tickets

- [Zhemchug Movie Tickets](https://tickets.vk.com/cheliabinsk/movie/zhemchug-24078): Movie tickets: Zhemchug film showtimes and booking in Cheliabinsk

## Voice Assistant & Skills

- [LIGA Lakii Marusia Skill](https://marusia.vk.com/skill/54473106): Marusia voice assistant skill for sports league management and statistics
